title: Lumen Metabolism Reading Weekly Flex Score Trend
dataSources: HRV (`hrv:reading`), blood oxygen (`spo2:reading`), lab panels (`bloodpanel:result`), supplements (`supplement:intake`), continuous glucose (`cgm:glucose`), sleep-apnea events (`apnea:event`), body composition (`bodycomp:measure`), blood pressure (`bloodpressure:reading`).
app: Biohacking data — HRV straps, pulse oximeters, blood-pressure cuffs, continuous glucose monitors, body-composition scales, lab-result exports, and supplement logs — ingested to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=lumen:metabolism flex_score=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(flex_score) as avg_duration, max(flex_score) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst flex score for Lumen metabolism reading events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture flex_score on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average flex score with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It lets you whether Lumen metabolism reading tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
